notes.title: Final update (probably)
notes.notes: Balanced a puzzle that people still found frustrating. Hopefully I haven't made it [i]too[/i] easy.

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!
2024 was a year. Hopefully 2025 continues this trend.

Thank you everyone for playing and enjoying Moaisland. I have loved reading all of the reviews and seeing what people think of the game. It makes me very happy to see it bringing joy to people around the world.

Peace and Love,
Yours in Moai,
The Moaisland Team
